## CredentialService.processOffer() method

Process a received [OfferCredentialMessage](./core.offercredentialmessage.md). This will not accept the credential offer or send a credential request. It will only create a new credential record with the information from the credential offer message. Use after calling this method to create a credential request.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
processOffer(messageContext: InboundMessageContext<OfferCredentialMessage>): Promise<CredentialRecord>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter      | Type                                                                                                                       | Description                                                 |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| messageContext | [InboundMessageContext](./core.inboundmessagecontext.md)&lt;[OfferCredentialMessage](./core.offercredentialmessage.md)&gt; | The message context containing a credential request message |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[CredentialRecord](./core.credentialrecord.md)&gt;

credential record associated with the credential offer message
